events.title: Full Creative Control Within Brief
must_haves: The deliverable is one video lasting approximately 6 seconds.
A tiny robot is visibly present.
A recognizable sunflower is visibly present.
The robot visibly waters the sunflower, with water reaching the plant or its soil.

answer_sheet.Subject and action: A tiny robot watering a sunflower.

events.text: I'd like you to make a video for me, and I'm leaving most of the creative decisions up to you. I just like the thought of a little moment of kindness, which is why this idea appealed to me. What I have in mind is a tiny robot watering a sunflower, and the video should be 6 seconds long. I sometimes overthink creative choices, so I'm happy not to be the one deciding them this time. Everything else is your call—surprise me.
